chunks: Ali, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Strive (in Jihad), you will acquire (gain spoils/victory).'

key_terms.تَغْنَمُوا: You will acquire/gain (referring to spoils of war or spiritual reward)

ai.seo_question: What is the promise of Jihad according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi’s chapter on the merits of Jihad, this concise prophetic maxim (hadeeth) underscores the Shia emphasis on active striving (jihad) as the prerequisite for divine success. It reflects the theological principle that spiritual and material gain (ghanimah) is contingent upon sincere effort, a concept deeply rooted in both early Islamic history and Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 14. Ali has narrated from father, from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
You must do Jihad; you will benefit.’”
